children.description: Counts the number of completed test attempts by counting rows in the attempt table.
Counts the number of attempt records where the passed flag is TRUE, representing the total count of passed tests.
Calculates the number of failed tests by subtracting Passed Tests from Completed Tests.
Calculates the average of the 'score' values across all records in the 'attempt' table.
Calculates the average test duration in minutes across all attempts in the 'attempt' table.
Counts the number of unique test takers based on the distinct candidate_key values in the attempt table.
Calculates the completion rate as the ratio of completed tests to total registrations.
Calculates the year to date total of completed tests based on the 'Date'[calendar_date] column.
Calculates the completed tests for the same year-to-date period in the previous calendar year, based on the Completed Tests Year to Date measure and the calendar date from the Date table.
Calculates the year over year percentage change in completed tests by comparing completed tests year to date with completed tests for the same year to date period in the previous year.
Calculates the year-to-date pass rate by evaluating [Pass Rate] over all dates from the start of the calendar year up to the current filter context date.
Calculates the year over year change in the pass rate by subtracting Pass Rate Previous Year Year to date from Pass Rate Year to date.
Calculates the total gross payments amount by summing 'finance'[amount] for transactions where 'finance'[transaction_type] equals "STRING LITERAL".
Calculates the total refund amount as the negative sum of 'finance'[amount] for rows where 'finance'[transaction_type] equals "STRING LITERAL".
Counts the number of rows in the finance table where the transaction_type is equal to 'STRING LITERAL'.
Counts the number of refund transactions in the 'finance' table by counting rows where the transaction_type equals the specified refund code.
Calculates the refund rate as the ratio of the number of refunds to the total number of payments.
Calculates total net revenue by summing the Amount field from the finance table.
Calculates the average revenue generated for each completed test by dividing Net Revenue by Completed Tests.
Calculates net revenue year to date based on the selected 'Date'[calendar_date] context.

Calculates net revenue year to date for the same period in the previous calendar year based on the 'Date'[calendar_date] column, typically for year-over-year comparison against current year-to-date net revenue.
Calculates the year-over-year percentage change in net revenue by comparing current year-to-date net revenue to the previous year-to-date net revenue.
Total Number of Registrations
Counts the number of distinct registered candidates based on the candidate_key in the registration table.
Calculates the average number of registrations per unique registered candidate by dividing total registrations by the count of unique registered candidates.
Calculates the year-to-date total of registrations based on the 'Date'[calendar_date] context.
Returns the year-to-date registrations for the same period in the previous calendar year, using the Date[calendar_date] column to shift the [Registrations YTD] measure one year back.
Calculates the year-over-year percentage change in year-to-date registrations compared to the previous year's year-to-date registrations.
Counts the total number of rows in the 'response' table to return the total number of responses.
Counts the number of responses marked as correct in the 'response' table.
Calculate the number of incorrect responses by subtracting Correct Responses from Total Responses.
Calculates the percentage of topic accuracy by dividing the number of correct responses by the total responses.
Calculates the average response time in seconds across all response records.
Calculates the average number of points earned across all response records.
